items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: he made Will Hudson our arranger... I remember that junk like drum... Will Hudson used to write

ctx.x: And you -- do you remember the first recording that you made with the band?
No. I remember that junk like drum (inaudible) Will Hudson used to write, because he was working out at Mills' office, Irving Mills' office.
This was after you got to New York.
